svg.text: Long leg (horizontal, toward the well): 543 to the bend's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: corner; short leg (vertical, into the box): 430

svg.text: to the corner. Developed length about 0.95 m.

svg.text: Mark the bend from the corner back along each leg; bend, then

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: check the angle with a square and trim the ends to length.

svg.text: Cut with a hacksaw or tube cutter, ream the ends so the bore

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cannot cut the cable, and paint each cut end with zinc-rich paint.

svg.text: of the flexible tail over the well.
